lessons: Premise contradiction confirmed: tests/integration/test_host_mechanical.py:469 test_coverage_fail_closed[None-False-ok] declares coverage.json, writes none, exits 0 and expects outcome ok. The ticket's required missing-coverage failure turns that into gate_failed.

The ticket's Scope in and criterion 7 say test_coverage_recorded_for_changed_files is the only expectation that may change in test_host_mechanical.py. The (None, False, "ok") case therefore cannot pass. Amend the ticket to allow changing it to gate_failed.

When amending, list test_coverage_fail_closed[None-False-ok] in Scope in and add an acceptance criterion that it expects gate_failed with a 'Missing or invalid coverage report' finding. Then run clutch lint and clutch review again.

Before re-confirming, grep tests/ for other cases that declare coverage, write no report and exit 0 while expecting ok or pass. Allow each one in the same amendment so the next attempt is not stopped by a second premise failure.
